text: CI runner rejected acceptance.md: exit 2, zero commands extracted, ci-results.json not written. Your table format is not parseable. Rewrite acceptance.md using the exact structure of .collab/tasks/001/acceptance.md (on main): one check per '## ' section, each check body a fenced block whose FIRST line is the runnable command, then bullet assertions. No tables, no '###' subsections. Verify locally with 'node scripts/check-traceability.mjs' before finishing.

CI still fails with exit 2 and zero commands. Your acceptance.md must contain fenced command blocks only: each check is a '## ' section whose body starts with a triple-backtick fence containing ONE runnable command line, followed by bullet assertions. Tables and inline command cells are invisible to the runner. Copy the structure of .collab/tasks/001/acceptance.md exactly.

Runner contract (authoritative, read from tools/ci-runner.ps1 header). Rewrite acceptance.md to exactly this shape:

## AC-009 Test entry
- 命令: <one single-line command here in backticks>
- 期望: ...

Rules:
1. Every check heading must start with the AC id, e.g. "## AC-009 ...". A prefix like "A-1" before the AC id is NOT recognised.
2. The command goes on a line beginning with "- 命令: " and wrapped in a single backtick pair. Fenced code blocks and tables are NOT parsed at all.
3. The pass criterion is: exit code 0 AND stdout contains the exact string "AC-009 OK". So every command must end by printing that string, e.g. ...; Write-Output "AC-009 OK".
4. Cover each AC you own with its own "## AC-xxx" section.

Do not use code fences. Do not use tables.
